# Ellen West

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c13 P24](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0024)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Norman Douglas  <sub>[v5 c26 P17](../source/v05-c26.md#nw-v05-c26-p0017), [v5 c32 P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 c32 P24](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0024), [v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Ellen is dark, tall, and massive, with black hair and thick black eyebrows. Her eyes are a clear, slaty blue resembling gulf water in a north wind. She has a stern, forbidding look, but she can possess a glowing scarlet cheek from frost and a stately figure.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P54](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0054), [v5 c13 P25](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0025), [v5 c22 P8](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0008)_

## Personality

Ellen has a stern appearance but is in reality very jolly, boasting a gurgling laugh and a deep, mellow, pleasantly masculine voice. She possesses an almost masculine understanding, a sharp sense of humour, and splendid sincerity, with an interest in world politics and world events. However, she can be intense, grim, and intensely fearful of solitude, holding fiercely to vows and controlling her sister.

_Sources: [v5 c4 P54](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0054), [v5 c12 P5](../source/v05-c12.md#nw-v05-c12-p0005), [v5 c13 P25](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0025), [v5 c21 P8](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0008), [v5 c21 P10](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0010), [v5 c21 P20](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0020), [v5 c22 P8](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0008), [v5 c22 P22](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0022)_

- To avoid being left alone in life  <sub>[v5 c21 P20](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0020), [v5 c22 P30](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0030)</sub>
- To keep her family vows and ensure her sister keeps hers  <sub>[v5 c13 P40](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0040), [v5 c21 P12](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0012), [v5 c22 P28](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0028)</sub>

## History

Ellen West grew up in the West homestead with her family. In her girlhood, she had a romance with Norman Douglas, but it broke off after a quarrel, leading Norman to marry Hester Reese out of spite. Following her mother's death on Rosemary's twenty-fifth birthday, Ellen fell into deep grief and feared being left alone. She exacted a solemn vow from her sister Rosemary, sworn on their mother's Bible, that neither of them would ever marry and leave each other. Years later, when John Meredith began visiting their home and sought to marry Rosemary, Ellen held her sister strictly to her promise, refusing to set her free. However, after meeting Norman Douglas at a silver wedding party, Ellen resumed her own old courtship with him. Recognizing that she wanted to marry Norman, she sought Rosemary's release from their former vow. Ultimately, both sisters agreed to release each other, allowing Rosemary to accept John Meredith while Ellen prepared to marry Norman in a navy blue dress.

_Sources: [v5 c13 P40](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0040), [v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015), [v5 c21 P17](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0017), [v5 c21 P20](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0020), [v5 c21 P24](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0024), [v5 c22 P1](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0001), [v5 c22 P22](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0022), [v5 c22 P28](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0028), [v5 c32 P12](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0012), [v5 c32 P24](../source/v05-c32.md#nw-v05-c32-p0024), [v5 c34 P41](../source/v05-c34.md#nw-v05-c34-p0041), [v5 c35 P3](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0003), [v5 c35 P7](../source/v05-c35.md#nw-v05-c35-p0007)_

## Background by volume

- Raised in the West family home as a strong Episcopalian  <sub>[v5 c2 P66](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0066), [v5 c13 P6](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0006), [v5 c14 P39](../source/v05-c14.md#nw-v05-c14-p0039)</sub>
- Had a youthful romance with Norman Douglas that ended in a quarrel  <sub>[v5 c15 P31](../source/v05-c15.md#nw-v05-c15-p0031), [v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015)</sub>
- Lost her father at age thirteen and her twelve-year-old brother five years later  <sub>[v5 c21 P15](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0015)</sub>
- Made a mutual oath with Rosemary over their mother's Bible never to marry  <sub>[v5 c21 P24](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0024), [v5 c22 P26](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0026)</sub>

## Quotes

> Mark my words, Mr. Meredith, that man is going to fight somebody yet. He’s aching to. He is going to set the world on fire.  <sub>[v5 c13 P27](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0027)</sub>

> Rosemary West, that man has a notion of courting you.  <sub>[v5 c13 P31](../source/v05-c13.md#nw-v05-c13-p0031)</sub>

> I think it is just as well to be interested in things as long as you live. If you’re not, it doesn’t seem to me that there’s much difference between the quick and the dead.  <sub>[v5 c21 P9](../source/v05-c21.md#nw-v05-c21-p0009)</sub>

> I will not do it. A promise is a promise in my eyes. I will not do it. Break your promise—be forsworn if you will—but it shall not be with any assent of mine.  <sub>[v5 c22 P28](../source/v05-c22.md#nw-v05-c22-p0028)</sub>
